Index.heroDesc: GESIS mobilizes youth, communities, and partners to promote solidarity, empowerment, and sustainable development in Benin and Africa.

mission.label: Who we are
mission.title: An organization born from the conviction that every young person matters.
mission.desc1: GESIS is a humanitarian, apolitical, and non-denominational NGO, founded to promote community fulfillment through youth empowerment, civic participation, and social innovation.
mission.desc2: Our vision: to build a world where each emerging generation, united and committed, actively contributes to sustainable, inclusive, and humanly just development.

About.heroDesc: An organization born from the conviction that every young person, every woman, every community deserves the means to flourish and contribute to a fairer world.
About.identityP1: The NGO GESIS — Emerging Generation for Solidarity and Social Impact — is a national and international non-profit non-governmental organization.
About.identityP2: Formerly named "Amical Sourou Denis AHISSOU" in 2020, GESIS formalized its commitment during its General Assembly on September 28, 2025 (law n° 2025-19 of the Republic of Benin).
About.identityP3: A humanitarian, apolitical and non-denominational organization, its headquarters is established in the Village of Drogbo, Adjarra, in the Ouémé department in Benin.
About.infoHQVal: Village of Drogbo, Maison AHISSOU, Adjarra, Ouémé, Benin
About.timelineDesc: The key milestones that have shaped GESIS since its creation.

timelineItems.title: Foundation — Amical Sourou Denis AHISSOU
timelineItems.desc: Creation of the organization by a group of committed young people, driven by the conviction that youth is a lever for development.

timelineItems.title: Membership in Youth For Peace Benin
timelineItems.desc: GESIS officially joins the national platform and integrates the Commission in charge of communication and advocacy.

timelineItems.title: Constituent General Assembly
timelineItems.desc: Official adoption of the statutes and launch of GESIS (law n° 2025-19).

timelineItems.title: Festisol Ouémé
timelineItems.desc: Active participation in the Festival of Solidarities and receipt of the certificate of recognition.

timelineItems.title: Expansion of activities
timelineItems.desc: Digital peace campaign, electoral observation, Nature University, webinars and recruitment of volunteers.

timelineItems.title: Booming
timelineItems.desc: Development of new projects and strengthening of partnerships in Benin and Africa.

About.govDesc: GESIS has rigorous and transparent governance, defined by its statutes and internal regulations.

govBlocks.title: General Assembly
govBlocks.desc: Composed of all members up to date with their commitments. Meets in ordinary session once a year (January). Defines major orientations, approves reports and can modify statutes.

govBlocks.title: Board of Directors
govBlocks.desc: Composed of a President, a General Secretary, a General Treasurer and two advisory members. Renewable 5-year term. Defines strategies and controls the Executive Direction.

govBlocks.title: Auditors
govBlocks.desc: Composed of two members. Verifies the regularity and sincerity of annual accounts, evaluates financial management procedures and formulates independent recommendations.

govBlocks.title: Executive Direction
govBlocks.desc: Ensures daily management and execution of projects. Includes an Executive Director, an Administrative Manager, an Accountant, a Program Officer, a Communication Officer and a Partnership Officer.
